other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant's guardian/parents must be citizens of India
Applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be pursuing a regular course of studies in a recognized institution
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance from the Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST students or any other central/state scholarship schemes
Applicant must not be a government or non‑government employee
Applicant must not be a repeater in the same class more than once
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fee assistance ranging from ₹1,105 to ₹2,235 depending on class and stream.
